gaps.explanation: The business-type statement lines come from the proprietary Statement of Cash Flows (p7, Total): suppliers 69,450 + employees 29,594 + capital assets 29,274 + interest 11,038 + loan principal 11,021 = 150,377. The detail lines come from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position (p6): Water 87,176 + 9,370 = 96,546, Sewer 71,572 + 1,668 = 73,240, total 169,786. The difference is basis only: p6 includes Depreciation and amortization 59,704 (Water 43,127 + Sewer 16,577), which is not a cash payment, while p7 includes cash paid for capital assets 29,274 (Water) and loan principal 11,021 (Sewer), which are not expenses. 59,704 - 29,274 - 11,021 = 19,409 = schedule 169,786 - statement 150,377. The remaining parts agree exactly: p6 operating expenses excluding depreciation 158,748 - 59,704 = 99,044 = p7 suppliers 69,450 + employees 29,594; interest 11,038 on both. No detail line is wrong or missing.
